### The Spirit inside You
Author: J.D. Greear
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/spirit-inside-you
Passage: John 16:7
Points:
- Serving God in mere human effort causes burnout, but the Spirit turns duty into delight.
- Having the Holy Spirit dwelling inside believers is more advantageous than having Jesus physically beside them.
- The Holy Spirit is an actual person who desires intimate fellowship, not an abstract force.
- The early church transformed the world by following and relying on the Spirit's power.
- Believers today need the Spirit to conquer sin and pursue God's specific callings.

### Day 218: John 16:12–15
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-218-john-16-1215.html
Passage: John 16:12-15
Points:
- Fruitful ministry and spiritual teaching come solely through the Holy Spirit rather than human ability.
- Believers are invited to daily seek the fullness of the Christ-empowered life.
- God’s supply of the Spirit is limitless and available without measure.
- Christians should avoid asking for spiritual manifestations out of selfish pride or a desire to test God.
- The right motive for seeking the Spirit's filling is bringing glory to God through our lives.
